newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end lower on liquidation.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended lower across the board on Wednesday as long-liquidation, particularly in nearby months, pressured the market, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.6 yen to 2.5 yen per kg lower. Benchmark February stood 0.6 yen weaker at 144.1 yen.
Activity was lacklustre in the absence of fresh factors.

"An expected increase in Japan's rubber stocks prompted investors to liquidate their longs in nearbys," an analyst at a commodity broker said. Price losses in distant months were limited due to some fresh buying. "We believe the distant months have more room to rise," the analyst said.
